semantics.access: Read-only copies of existing RAM state. No FatFs, arbitrary symbols, addresses, watch expressions, callbacks, memory writes or SWD. Observations never authorize START.
semantics.paging: Cursor zero begins the fixed bounded catalog. Each nonterminal page has one unique ID and a strictly increasing next_cursor <= 16. Terminal page has end=1 and next_cursor=0. Publish only after the advertised entry count is received; partial scans are discarded for file jobs or disconnect.
semantics.timing: The firmware does not enforce a client request rate. GSHC uses one serial owner, at most one diagnostic exchange per idle scheduler step, and waits at least polling_ms between completed cycles. It pauses diagnostic polling during file operations. Counts and byte limits do not establish target WCET.
semantics.freshness: age_ms=4294967295 means sample age unknown. Host receive age is separate and keeps increasing. work_age_ms measures actual completed sink writes only; success does not prove fsync/durability. data_age_ms is sensor/estimator data time and never task completion or sensor-online proof. Independent rows are not one atomic whole-system snapshot.
semantics.progress: Optional progress_done/progress_total represents finite work only, both required together, total > 0 and done <= total. Periodic tasks and loop existence have no invented percentage.
semantics.compatibility: Keep all pre-existing maintenance 0.0 command arguments, response formats and errors. Ignore unknown optional fields; reject incompatible critical schema/access/bounds. Unknown state displays UNKNOWN. New same-schema IDs render without GUI code changes. Legacy FINAL uses only actual SYSTEM INFO/STATUS/CAPABILITIES and LOG STATUS text fields; missing diagnostics or LOGFILE capability remains explicitly unavailable.
semantics.identity: Stable entry IDs describe source meaning; sequence/counters are not boot or device identity. No resume/delete authorization is derived from diagnostics. File service v1 is negotiated separately.
